line: Give the gift of an unhurried goodbye.
paragraph: Zoë was twenty-two, new to the flight deck, and her captain that day was her father. Her mother moved through the cabin below, tending passengers on the Dutch airline flying out of Amsterdam. None of them had planned this; the roster aligned by surprise. Three family members in one thin metal tube above the North Sea, each in their own KLM uniform. Zoë could have rushed through the checks, eager to prove herself. Instead she let the pre-flight briefing stretch, her father's voice steady beside her, her mother's footsteps audible through the galley curtain. They flew home together.

seed.summary: A young pilot flew a commercial jet alongside her father as captain for the first time—while her mother worked in the cabin crew on the same flight. 22-year-old Zoë took to the skies with both her parents aboard the Dutch airline KLM flying out of Amsterdam. seed.sourceTitle: Daughter Gets to Join Dad as Co-Pilot, With Mom Serving on Flight’s Cabin Crew: A Surprise Full Circle Moment
